body:
My best friend and I 'M' met up to smoke a bowl one late night and talk about our days. I decided to surprise her and bring some ketamine (powdered form). We are both experienced users but, nothing could have prepared us for what we were unknowingly about to enter.
We started off by doing a bump of k each and packed a bowl of some farily good weed. We waited a few minutes and the ketamine didn't seem to kick in at all. So we sparked up the bowl and got about 6 hits each. Then all of the sudden things started to get overwhealming.
I knew that doing k right before blazing is/was risky since it's known to put people into unexpencted k-holes though, we did it anyway.. SO after we smoked the bowl we started to lose control of ourselves. 'M' was talking VERY fast and I couldn't comprehend what she was saying at all. I laughed harder then I ever had at all and couldn't stop myself.
A few minutes later we both went into panic form cause we couldn't stop ourselves and our hearts were pounding enough to make us think we were on the verge of a heart attack.
I finally got a hold of myself long enough to scream 'STOPP!!'.
We both collected ourselves and tried to calm down.
And this is simply unexplainable...
We were staring down at our crossed legs when suddenly we went out of our bodies, at the same time.
My legs became computeried shapes and colours and everything else in the world was non-exsistant. 'M' had the same experience happen to her.
We both freaked out at the same time and came back to our bodies. I got up and walked around, 'M' followed and we decided the only way to fix the situation was to go home and sleep/relax.
We hugged and departed.
My walk home consisted of many strange feelings. I was hearing songs and voices in my head and kepts forgetting what was going on. My body felt lke it was made of cardboard and everything was melting and swaying as if I was on a lot of lsd.
When I got home I ran down to my bed and layed down. While I was lying there I kept falling out of my body into blackness every so often. The phone rang and I picked it up, knowing it was 'M' calling.
She claimed to hear voices and everything the same as well. Eventually we were to scared to talk, so we went to bed.
I got into my bed again and the experience got stronger and stronger until I lost complete conciousness.
I woke up the next morning relived to be alive. I still felt very disoriented though.
I should not have done k right before smoking
as I had a very frightening
experience.. I would like to try it again though, even though I was sure I was going to die, it was fun in the end.
